title: sessions: Decouple GitHub chat pills from the workspace
body:
## Summary

Recorded GitHub issues and pull requests currently fall back to the generic Artifacts/References pill when a session has no workspace or the link belongs to another repository.

- Resolve recorded GitHub artifacts and references independently of workspace metadata.
- Share the resolved references across dedicated chat pills, artifact de-duplication, and PR status polling.
- Preserve repository-discovered associations, stable removal IDs, keyboard opening, and unsupported-link fallback without changing the workspace's primary PR association.

## Validation

- `npm run gulp compile-client` — passed with zero errors.
- 56 focused Electron unit tests — passed, covering workspace-less issues/PRs, cross-repository links, removal, polling, and provider behavior.
- Targeted ESLint and `npm run valid-layers-check` — passed.

The aggregate compile task stopped on missing dependencies for an unrelated built-in extension; the client-only compile covering these changes passed.

To verify manually, record an issue or PR in a workspace-less quick chat, or record a link from another repository in a workspace session. It should appear in its dedicated GitHub pill, not the generic Artifacts/References pill, and remain openable and removable.
